newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech May real retail sales rise 3.1 pct - CSU.
newsitem.headline: Czech May real retail sales rise 3.1 pct - CSU.

text.p: Czech real retail sales rose 3.1 percent in Maycompared with the same month of 1996, putting growth in the first five months of the year at 1.1 percent, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Thursday.
The CSU added that total internal trade in May rose by 4.9 percent year-on-year, putting internal trade in the first five months of the year up 3.1 percent compared with the same period of 1996.
